title: Quasar populations across cosmic time
text: We build quasar samples across a broad redshift range and use luminosity functions to measure how their abundance and luminosity change over cosmic time. Wide-area surveys such as IMS and KS4 help us identify rare quasars and place their evolution in a statistical context.

title: Obscured quasars and black-hole growth
text: We study quasars whose optical light is reddened or obscured by dust. By combining optical and infrared spectral energy distributions with emission-line measurements, we examine how obscuration affects quasar demographics and what accretion rates reveal about black-hole growth.

title: SPHEREx survey science
text: We use SPHEREx all-sky near-infrared spectrophotometry to study the spectral energy distributions, redshifts, and population properties of quasars and galaxies. Our current work focuses on methods and analyses that make full use of this new survey dataset.
